items.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT x.household_id) FROM xref.client_xref x JOIN retail.account ra ON ra.customer_id = x.retail_customer_id JOIN retail.product p ON p.product_id = ra.product_id AND ra.status_code = 'OPEN' AND p.product_family IN ('current', 'savings') JOIN wealth.AUM_MNTH_END_FACT_1 w ON w.HSHLD_DK = x.household_id AND w.CLDR_EOM_DT = DATE '2025-03-31' AND w.AUM_AM > 0 WHERE x.certification_status = 'CERTIFIED' AND DATE '2025-03-31' BETWEEN x.valid_from AND coalesce(x.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')

items.question: For dual clients, deposits vs AUM and AUM share of total, 31 Mar 2025
items.reference_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM xref.client_xref x WHERE x.certification_status = 'CERTIFIED' AND DATE '2025-03-31' BETWEEN x.valid_from AND coalesce(x.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')), dep AS (SELECT x.household_id, sum(b.ledger_balance) AS d FROM x JOIN retail.account a ON a.customer_id = x.retail_customer_id JOIN retail.product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id AND p.product_family IN ('current', 'savings') JOIN retail.daily_balance b ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND b.as_of = DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY 1), aum AS (SELECT HSHLD_DK AS household_id, AUM_AM AS m FROM wealth.AUM_MNTH_END_FACT_1 WHERE CLDR_EOM_DT = DATE '2025-03-31') SELECT round(sum(d), 2) AS retail, round(sum(m), 2) AS wealth, round(sum(m) / nullif(sum(d) + sum(m), 0), 4) AS ratio FROM dep JOIN aum USING (household_id)

items.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xref.client_xref x JOIN retail.account ra ON ra.customer_id = x.retail_customer_id WHERE x.household_id = a.HSHLD_DK AND x.certification_status = 'CERTIFIED' AND f.DW_TRAN_DT BETWEEN x.valid_from AND coalesce(x.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') AND f.OFSET_SRCE_SYS_ID <> -1 AND ra.account_id = f.OFSET_ACCT_ID) THEN 'INTERNAL_FROM_RETAIL' ELSE 'EXTERNAL' END AS flow_class, round(sum(CASE WHEN f.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'O' THEN -f.TRAN_AM ELSE f.TRAN_AM END), 2) FROM wealth.TRAN_FACT_1 f JOIN wealth.MONTH_DIM_1 m ON m.CLDR_EOM_DT = last_day(f.DW_TRAN_DT) JOIN wealth.ACCT_DIM2_1 a ON a.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND a.SRCE_SYS_ID = f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID AND a.CURR_IN = 1 WHERE f.CURR_IN = 1 AND f.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'I' AND f.TRAN_AM > 0 AND a.TEST_ACCT_IN = 'N' AND m.CLDR_EOM_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-30' AND DATE '2025-06-30' AND m.DW_BRKRG_MNTH_FRM_TODAY_CT <> 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

items.question: Retail customers with average balance above $8,000 in June 2025: how many are covered by a wealth advisor, by advisor office?
items.reference_sql: WITH hi AS (SELECT a.customer_id FROM retail.daily_balance b JOIN retail.account a ON a.account_id = b.account_id WHERE b.as_of BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING avg(b.ledger_balance) > 8000), x AS (SELECT * FROM xref.client_xref x WHERE x.certification_status = 'CERTIFIED' AND DATE '2025-06-30' BETWEEN x.valid_from AND coalesce(x.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT coalesce(ad.BRCH_CD, 'UNCOVERED') AS office, count(DISTINCT hi.customer_id) FROM hi LEFT JOIN x ON x.retail_customer_id = hi.customer_id LEFT JOIN wealth.HSHLD_DIM_1 h ON h.HSHLD_DK = x.household_id LEFT JOIN wealth.ADV_DIM_1 ad ON ad.ADV_ID = h.PRIM_ADV_ID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
